patch_description: The current heuristic misses some slow I/Os (10.84% false admit rate) because it doesn't consider throughput trends, which are early indicators of system degradation. I'm adding throughput trend analysis and making the latency threshold more adaptive based on both historical latency and throughput patterns. When throughput is declining, it often precedes latency spikes, so we should be more aggressive in rejecting requests. Additionally, I'm refining the adaptive latency threshold to be more sensitive to recent performance degradation.
